meta.title: Story Conductor
meta.description: 一章先做什么、后做什么：排 runbook、校验收据、在作者拍板时停下。它不写正文，也不改兄弟插件的账本；装了它，本系列四个插件的开关由它统管。

name: Story Conductor
description: Decides what a chapter does first and next: runs the runbook, checks the receipts, and stops when the author has to make a call. It never writes prose and never edits sibling ledgers; while installed it is the master switch for the four novel plugins.

tools.cue_run: Start, resume, abort or inspect a chapter runbook
tools.cue_step: Submit the result of the current step
tools.cue_status: Inspect steps, waiting state, budget and capability matrix
